question: Is any repair shop an outlier on cost?

input.sql:
WITH p AS (SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) paid FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (claim_id,payment_date,amount,payee_type) * FROM claim_payments ORDER BY claim_id,payment_date,amount,payee_type, (load_batch LIKE 'nightly-%') DESC) GROUP BY 1),
c AS (SELECT c.repair_shop_id, c.cause, coalesce(p.paid,0)+c.reserve_amount inc FROM claims c LEFT JOIN p USING(claim_id) WHERE c.repair_shop_id IS NOT NULL),
cm AS (SELECT cause, avg(inc) cause_avg FROM c GROUP BY 1),
s AS (SELECT c.repair_shop_id, count(*) n, avg(inc) avg_cost, avg(inc/cm.cause_avg) idx FROM c JOIN cm USING(cause) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.*, r.name, r.state, r.metro, r.network_status FROM s JOIN repair_shops r USING(repair_shop_id) ORDER BY idx DESC LIMIT 12

report.interpretation: I read "cost" as average claim cost (incurred = paid + open reserve) per repair shop. That covers auto claims that have a repair shop: collision, glass and hail, for all loss dates. Because cause mix changes cost, I compared each shop with the all-shop average for the same cause. A shop's cost index is the average of its claims' cost divided by that cause average, so 1.0 is typical. I removed the 159 duplicated payment rows from the March 2026 reload before summing paid amounts. An outlier is a shop more than about 2 standard deviations above the other shops.
report.answer: Yes, one shop stands out: RS-041 Campbell Body Works (Chicago, IL, non-preferred). Across 79 claims its average cost is about $5,774. That is a cost index of 1.285, so about 29% above the typical cost for the same causes. Its z-score is 2.6 against the 48 shops, which have a mean index of 0.99 and a standard deviation of 0.11. No other shop passes 2 standard deviations. The next highest is RS-024 Johnston Body Works (GA) at 1.16, which has only 42 claims, and RS-043 Whitney Collision Center (NY) at 1.15. The gap holds within cause and against local peers. RS-041's collision claims average $6,935 (median $5,071) versus $4,437 (median $3,766) at other Illinois shops. Its glass claims average $864 versus $616. Its quarterly average rose from about $3.1k in early 2025 to about $9.0k in Q3 2026. Q3 2026 has only 14 claims, and recent claims may still be incomplete. This is a statistical flag only. It doesn't show overcharging, because damage severity could differ.

findings.claim: RS-041 is more expensive than other Illinois shops on collision claims and glass claims, so the gap isn't explained by cause mix.
findings.evidence_sql: WITH p AS (SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) paid FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (claim_id,payment_date,amount,payee_type) * FROM claim_payments ORDER BY claim_id,payment_date,amount,payee_type, (load_batch LIKE 'nightly-%') DESC) GROUP BY 1) SELECT CASE WHEN repair_shop_id='RS-041' THEN 'RS-041' WHEN state='IL' THEN 'other IL shops' ELSE 'all other shops' END grp, cause, count(*) n, round(avg(coalesce(p.paid,0)+reserve_amount)) avg_cost FROM claims c LEFT JOIN p USING(claim_id) WHERE repair_shop_id IS NOT NULL AND cause IN ('collision','glass','hail') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

data_quality_issues.issue: 159 claim_payments rows from the out-of-batch load reload-2026-03-14 duplicate existing payments.
data_quality_issues.impact: Left in, they would overstate paid amounts for some shops. I removed them, keeping the nightly-batch row.

data_quality_issues.issue: The latest loss months are incomplete because claims are reported late (about 79% of September 2026 claims are reported by the extract date). Open reserves are estimates, and some very large reserves exist (the largest is $178k).
data_quality_issues.impact: Recent averages, such as RS-041's Q3 2026 figure, are less reliable. A few large claims can move averages at low-volume shops.

proposed_actions.title: Review repair shop RS-041 Campbell Body Works (Chicago) estimates and invoices
proposed_actions.reason: Its average cost is about 29% above the cause-adjusted norm and rising. A review of invoices, large claims and the shop's adjusters would show whether this is real overcharging or just more severe damage.

proposed_actions.title: Remove the duplicate payment rows from reload-2026-03-14
